title: Did AI Just Prove the Riemann Hypothesis? Hormuz Tankers Burn, Meta Row in India | Daily Crux
description_html:
Has AI just solved the most famous unsolved problem in mathematics? An Anthropic researcher says he and Claude have a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, about 17 million lines of Lean code, and experts are still checking. Also: tankers are hit near the Strait of Hormuz as Iran says it controls the lane, Bahrain is attacked again, and India's Youth Congress gives Meta seven days over blocked opposition accounts.
